ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) A boat can travel with a speed of 14 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the stream is 5 km/hr, find the time taken by the boat to go 76 km downstream.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed downstream = (14 + 5) km/hr = 19 km/hr.

Time taken to travel 76 km downstream = (76/19) hours  
                                                                  = 4 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) A 1300 m long train crosses a tree in 130 sec, how much time will it take to pass a platform 800 m long?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Here
Length of a train is 1300m
Train took 130 sec to cross a tree
Length of a platform is 800m

Speed of the train = 1300/130 = 10 m/sec
Total distance = 1300 + 800 = 2100 m

Time = distance/speed
        = 2100/10 = 210 sec

∴ Time required to cross a platform is 210 sec.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) A boat running downstream covers a distance of 24 km in 3 hours while for covering the same distance upstream, it takes 4 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Rate downstream = (24/3) km/hr. = 8 km/hr.
Rate upstream = (24/4) km/hr. = 6 km/hr.

 The speed of the boat in still water = (1/2)(8 + 6) km/hr.
                                                          = (1/2) × 14 km/hr.
                                                           = 7 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) The time taken for the tail end of a train to cross a pole is 43 seconds. If the length of the train is 110 m and speed of the train is 54 km/hr. find the initial distance of the pole from the front end of the train.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
⇒ Speed of train = 54 × (5/18) = 15m/s
⇒ Distance covered in 43 seconds = 15 × 43 = 645 m
⇒ Length of train = 110m

∴ The initial distance of the pole from the front end of the train = 645 - 110 = 535 m

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) A boat covers a certain distance downstream in 1 hour, while it comes back in 7/2 hours. If the speed of the stream be 5 kmph, what is the speed of the boat in still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of the boat in still water be x kmph.
Then,
Speed downstream = (x + 5) kmph,
Speed upstream = (x - 5) kmph.

Now 
(x + 5) x 1 =(x - 5)(7/2)
2(x + 5) = 7(x - 5)
2x + 10 = 7x - 35 
7x - 2x = 35 +10 
5x = 45
x = 9 kmph

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) A 250 meters long train crosses a bridge 750 meters long in 20 seconds and crosses a platform in 16 seconds. Find the length of the platform.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the length of the platform be x

The speed of the train = (750 + 250)/20
                                    = 1000/20
                                    = 50 m/sec
Now, Again according to the question
The train crosses the platform in 16 seconds
250 + x = 50 × 16
⇒ x = 800 - 250
⇒ x = 550 m

∴ The length of the platform is 550 m.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) Speed of a boat in standing water is 10 kmph and the speed of the stream is 2.5 kmph. A man rows to a place at a distance of 112.5 km and comes back to the starting point. The total time taken by him is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed upstream = 7.5 kmph.
Speed downstream = 12.5 kmph.


∴ Total time taken =(112.5/7.5) +(112.5/12.5) 
                               = (15 + 9) hours 
                                = 24 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) A 225 m long train can cover a 405 m platform in 21 seconds. Find the speed of the train in km/hr is?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Length of platform = 405 m
Length of train = 225 m
Time taken to cover the length of train = 21 seconds
Distance need to cover = Length of platform + length of train
                                      = 405 + 225
                                     = 630 m
Speed of train = 630/21 = 30 m/s

∴ Speed of train = 30 × (18/5) = 6 × 18 = 108 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) A man can row at 5 kmph in still water. If the velocity of current is 1 km/hr and it takes him 1 hour to row to place and come back, how is the place?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed downstream =(5 + 1)kmph=6kmph
Speed upstream =(5 - 1)kmph=4kmph
Let the required distance be x km.

x/6 + x/4 = 1
2x+ 3x = 12
5x = 12 
x = 12/5 
x = 2.4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A train crosses two bridges of 400 m and 160 m in 110 sec and 60 sec respectively. The length of the train is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the length of the train be x m.
The train passes a bridge of length 400 m in 110 sec.
Speed of the train = (x + 400)/110...........(1)
The train passes another bridge of length 160 m in 60 sec.
Speed of the train = (x + 160)/60..............(2)

Equating equation (1) and (2),
⇒ (x + 400)/110 = (x + 160)/60
⇒ (x + 400) × 60 = (x + 160) × 110
⇒ (60x + 24000) = (110x + 17600)
⇒ 110x – 60x = 24000 – 17600
⇒ 50x = 6400
⇒ x = 6400/50
⇒ x = 128 m

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) The speed of a boat in still water is 17 kmph and the rate of current is 5 kmph. The distance travelled downstream in 12 minutes is :
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed downstream
= (17 + 5) kmph
= 22 kmph

Distance travelled = 22 × (12/60) km
                             = 4.4 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) Two trains, each 200 m long, moving in opposite directions, cross each other in 8 seconds. If one is moving twice as fast the other, then the speed of the slower train is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of the slower train be x m/sec.
Then, speed of the faster train = 2x m/sec.
Relative speed = (x + 2x) m/sec = 3x m/sec.

(200 + 200)/8= 3x
400/8 = 3x
x = (400/(3 × 8)
x = 50/3

Speed of the slower train = (50/3) × (18/5)
                                          = 60 km/hr

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) A boatman goes 2 km against the current of the stream in 1 hour and goes 1 km along the current in 10 minutes. How long will it take to go 9 km in stationary water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of upstream = 2 km/hr
Speed of downstream = 1 km/10 min
                                    = 1 km/(10/60) hr
                                    = 6 km/hr

Speed of boatman = (2 + 6)/2 = 4 km/hr

Time taken by boatman to go 9 km in stationary water
= 9/4 hr
= 2 hr + (1/4) × 60 min
= 2 hr 15 min

∴ Boatman will take 2 hr 15 min to go 9 km in stationary water.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) How many seconds will a 450 metre long train take to cross a man walking with a speed of 4 km/hr in the direction of the moving train if the speed of the train is 64 km/hr?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of the train relative to man
= (64 - 4) km/hr
= 60 km/hr
= 60× (5/18) sec
= 50/3 sec

Time taken to pass the man
=450 ×(3/50)
= 27 sec

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) The speed of a boat in still water is 30 km/hr. If the boat goes upstream for a distance of 25 km in 5 hours, find the speed of the stream.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of stream be x km/hr.
⇒ Speed of boat in still water =30 km/hr
⇒ Speed of boat in upstream = 25/5 = 5 km/hr

Also, speed of boat in upstream = speed of boat in still water - speed of stream
 5 = 30 - x
x = 30 - 5 
x = 25 
∴ The speed of stream is 25 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) A 180 m long train crosses a milestone in 18 seconds and a train of same length coming from the opposite direction in 12 seconds. The speed of the other train is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of first train = 180/18 m/sec
                               = 10 m/sec

Let the speed of second train be x m/sec
Relative speed = (10 + x) m/sec

Here
360/(10 + x) = 12
12(10 + x) = 360
120 + 12x = 360
12x = 360 - 120 
12x = 240 
x = 20 m/sec
x = 20 × (18/5) km/hr
x = 72 km/hr

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) A man can swim a distance of 360 m in still water in 4 minutes. If the speed of the current is 1 m / sec, how much time will he take to cover the distance of 180 m upstream?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Distance covered by a man by swimming in still water = 360 m
Time taken by man = 4 minutes = 240 seconds
Speed of man = 360/240 = (3/2) m/sec
Speed of stream is = 1 m/sec.

Time taken in upstream 
= 180/[(3/2) - 1)]
 = 180/(1/2)
= 360 seconds
⇒ Time = 6 minutes

∴ He will cover 150 m upstream in 6 minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) A 240 metre long train crosses a platform thrice its length in 60 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Length of train = 240 m
Length of platform = (3 × 240) m = 720m

∴Speed of train (240 + 720)/60 m/sec
                          = 960/60 m/sec
                          = 16 × (18/5) km/hr
                           = 57.6 km/hr

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) A rowing team rows a boat and covers a distance of 18 km in 6 hours while going upstream. When they go downstream, they cover a distance of 30 km in 5 hours. Find the speed of the boat in still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The boat covers 15 km upstream in 5 hours and 24 km downstream in 4 hours
According to the question,
Downstream speed = 30/5 = 6 km/h
Upstream speed = 18/6 = 3 km/h

∴ Speed of the Boat in still water = 1/2 × (6 + 3) = 4.5 km/h

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) Two trains of equal length are running on parallel lines in the same direction at 56 km/hr and 46 km/hr. The faster train passes the slower train in 36 seconds. The length of each train is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the length of each train be x metres.
Distance covered = 2x metres.
Relative speed = (56 - 46) km/hr
                        = 10 km/hr
                         = 10 × (5/18)
                         = 25/9 m/sec
Now
2x/36 = 25/9
2x = 36 × (25/9)
2x = 100
x = 50

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) A man can row 12 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the current is 4 km/hr, he takes 3 hours more upstream than downstream. What is the distance (in km)?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of the man in still water = 12 km/h
Speed of the current = 4 km/h
Speed of the man along the current = (12 + 4) km/h = 16 km/h
Speed of the man against the current = (12 -  4) km/h = 8 km/h


Let, The distance is x km
Now
 x/8 – x/16 = 3
=(2x - x)/16 = 3
= x/16 = 3 
∴ x = 48 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) Two trains A and B start running together from the same point in the same direction, at the speed of 60 kmph and 72 kmph respectively. If the length of each of the trains is 210 meters, how long will it take for B to cross train A?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Relative speed = (72 - 60) km/hr
                       = 12 km/hr
                       = 12 × (5/18) m/sec
                       = 10/3 m/sec

Total distance covered = Sum of lengths of trains = (210 + 210) m = 420 m
Time taken = (420 × 3)/10sec=126sec

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) A man takes 2.2 times as long to row a distance upstream as to row the same distance downstream. If he can row 55 km downstream in 2 hour 30 minutes, what is the speed of the boat in the still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of the boat in downstream  = 55/2.5
                                                       =(55 × 10)/25 = 22km/hr.

Speed of the boat in upstream = 22/2.2= (22 × 10)/22 =10km/hr.


∴ Speed of the boat in still water = (22 + 10)/2 = 16km/hr.
                                                      =  16km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) Two trains are running in opposite directions with the same speed. If the length of each train is 150 metres and they cross each other in 15 seconds, then the speed of each train (in km/hr) is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of each train be x m/sec.
Then, relative speed of the two trains = 2x m/sec.
Now
2x  =(150 + 150)/15
2x = 300/15
2x = 20 
x = 10 


Speed of each train = 10 m/sec
                                = 10 × (18/5) km/hr    
                                 = 36 km/hr

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) The speed of the boat in still water is 5 times that of current, it takes 1.1 hour to row to point B from point A downstream. The distance between point A and point B is 26.4 km. How much distance (in km) will it cover in 330 minutes upstream?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of the current be x kmph
Then speed of the boat in still water = 5x
∴Downstream speed = (5x + x) = 6x kmph
Upstream speed = (5x - x) = 4x kmph


According to question,
1.1 × 6x = 26.4
⇒6.6x =26.4
⇒x =26.4/6.6
∴x = 4kmph
∴Upstream speed = 4x = 4 × 4 = 16 kmph

330 minutes = 5(1/2) hours = 11/2 hours

∴Required distance travelled upstream = Speed × Time
                                                                = 16 × (11/2) hours
                                                                = 88 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) Two trains 180 m and 170 m long run at the speed of 60 km/hr and 40 km/hr respectively in opposite directions on parallel tracks. The time (in seconds) which they take to cross each other, is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Relative speed = (60 + 40) km/hr 
                        = 100 km/hr 
                       = 100 × (5/18) m/sec
                       = 250/9 m/sec

Distance covered in crossing each other = (180 + 170) m = 350 m

Required time = 350 × (9/250) 
                       = 12.6 sec

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) A boat takes 6 hours to cover a distance while travelling upstream, whereas while travelling downstream it takes 4 hours. If the speed of the current is 6 kmph, what is the speed of the boat in still water?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of the boat in still water be x kmph 
Then Speed downstream = (x + 6) kmph 
Speed up stream = (x - 6) kmph 

Now 
(x + 6) × 4 = (x - 6) × 6 
4x + 24 = 6x - 36
6x - 4x = 36 + 24 
2x = 60
x = 30 kmph

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৮) A 280 metres long train running at the speed of 120 kmph crosses another train running in opposite direction at the speed of 80 kmph in 9 seconds. What is the length of the other train?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Relative speed = (120 + 80) km/hr
                          = 200 km/hr
                          = 200 ×(5/18) m/sec
                           = 500/9 m/sec

Let the length of the other train be x metres.
Now
(x + 280)/9 = 500/9
x + 280 = 500
x  = 500 - 280 
x = 220

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) A man can row 34/3 kmph in still water and finds that  it takes him thrice as much time to row up than as to row down the same distance in the river. The speed of the current is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let speed upstream be x kmph
Then speed downstream = 3x kmph
Speed in still water = (1/2)​(3x + x)kmph
                              =2x kmph

Now 
2x = 34/3
x  = (34/3) × 2
x = 17/3

So Speed upstream = 17/3 km/hr
Speed downstream = 17 km/hr

Hence speed of the current =(1/2){17 - (17/3)} km/hr.
                                             = (1/2)(51 - 17)/3 km/hr.
                                            = (1/2)(34/3) km/hr.
                                              = 17/3 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) A train takes 50 seconds to cross the 204 m long bridge. If the same train takes 20 seconds to cross a board, then tell the length of the train. (In meters)
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the length of the train be x m.
Length of the bridge = 204 m

Now
⇒ (x + 204)/50 = x/20
(x + 204)/5 = x/2
⇒ 2x + 408 = 5x
5x - 2x = 408 
3x = 408
x = 136

∴ Length of the train is 136 m
